developmentChanges.title: Proposal velocity priority
developmentChanges.reason: Track proposal-count growth between runs for freelance jobs; prioritize low-competition opportunities before they cross saturation thresholds instead of ranking only by current proposal count.

developmentChanges.title: Client hire-signal confidence
